decisions.reason: Foldable large containers are core to returnable packaging for automotive and pooling customers, and missing website evidence for 2020-2021 is not a clear sign that results fell below aspiration.
Stackable crates are a staple standard line with broad food and retail demand, so the lack of recent visibility does not justify problemistic search or withdrawal.
The medium-duty rackable pallet costs little to keep within the pallet portfolio and is likely near aspiration, though its low prominence makes a quiet phase-out somewhat more plausible.
The spill-retention pallet serves an industrial niche, and slack lets a large firm carry it despite uncertain results and no observed website presence since 2019.

This single-model niche pallet has been invisible for two years, which hints at weak results, but it is not yet clearly below aspiration and the cost of keeping it is low, so it is kept for one more year.
